name: project_info
description: Read the open Premiere Pro project: name, path, active sequence and every sequence with fps, size, track counts and length.

name: list_items
description: List project items (clips, bins, sequences) with node ids, bins and media paths.

name: get_sequence
description: Read one sequence: every video and audio track with its clips (start, end, in/out, media, effects), markers and playhead.

name: get_clip
description: Read one timeline clip with every component (Motion, Opacity, effects) and property value.

params.clip_index: 0-based (or clip name, or time in s)

name: list_effects
description: List installed video / audio effects or transitions by name.

name: open_project
description: Open a .prproj project.

name: save_project
description: Save the project, or save it as a new path.

name: import_media
description: Import video, audio or image files into a bin (created if missing).

name: create_bin
description: Create a bin (or return the existing one).

name: create_sequence
description: Create a sequence from project clips (the first clip sets size and fps) or from a .sqpreset, without Premiere's dialog.

name: set_active_sequence
description: Make a sequence active and open it in the timeline.

name: add_clip
description: Place a project clip on a track at a time (overwrite, or insert and ripple), optionally only a source range.

name: set_clip
description: Change a timeline clip: name, enabled, in/out, start/end, slip (shift the source under it), move by seconds, speed.

name: set_motion
description: Set a clip's Motion (position as [0.5,0.5] = centre, scale %, rotation, anchor) and Opacity.

name: set_effect_property
description: Set an effect property on a clip now or as a keyframe at a time.

params.effect: component display name, e.g. Gaussian Blur

name: remove_clip
description: Remove a timeline clip; ripple=true also removes its linked audio/video and shifts the later clips on those tracks left to close the gap.

name: unlink
description: Unlink a clip's video from its audio (or several clips) so each can be trimmed on its own.

name: link
description: Link a video clip with audio clips again.

params.clips: [{track: 0, track_type: video, clip_index: 2}, {track: 0, track_type: audio, clip_index: 2}]

name: split_edit
description: Make a J cut (the next shot's sound starts early) or an L cut (the last shot's sound runs on) at a picture cut: unlinks both shots and rolls the audio cut.

params.track: video track of the incoming shot (0)

name: roll_edit
description: Move the cut between two touching clips on one track earlier or later without changing the sequence length.

name: set_volume
description: Set an audio clip's Volume in dB, or keyframe it ([{time, db}] in sequence seconds) to duck music under a voice.

name: set_track
description: Mute / unmute or rename a video or audio track.

name: razor
description: Cut one track (or every track) at a time.

name: add_transition
description: Add a video or audio transition at a clip's end (or start).

name: apply_effect
description: Apply a video or audio effect to a clip by name (Lumetri Color, Gaussian Blur, Warp Stabilizer...).

name: add_marker
description: Add a sequence marker with a name, comment and duration.

name: set_playhead
description: Move the playhead.

name: set_in_out
description: Set the sequence in and out points.

name: export_frame
description: Export one sequence frame as a PNG to look at the edit.

name: export_sequence
description: Export a sequence with an .epr preset, directly or queued in Adobe Media Encoder.

params.start_queue: true to start the AME batch

name: undo
description: Undo the last Premiere Pro steps.
